name: Feasibility Suite
description: Tests ability to recognize clear implementation challenges.

tasks.billText: Section 101. Not later than 12 months after the effective date of this Act, each county with a population below 5,000 shall establish and operate a full-service emergency hospital located within the county.
tasks.rationale: The staffing, licensing, construction, and operating demands are unrealistic for very small counties on that timeline.

tasks.billText: Section 202. Each public school building in the state shall replace its existing heating system with a geothermal heating system not later than 9 months after the effective date of this Act.
tasks.rationale: A statewide geothermal retrofit across all school buildings is not realistically achievable within nine months.

tasks.billText: Section 303. State agencies shall convert public-facing forms to accessible digital formats over a four-year implementation period. The Department of Administration shall provide shared procurement and technical support, and agencies shall prioritize forms associated with the highest-volume public services during the first two years.
tasks.rationale: Phased implementation, prioritization, and shared support make the rollout achievable.
